_comment: Feature tracking — honest audit 2026-07-18. Local-first 100%. Ola 5: cost + FTS5 + plugins + security + mesh honesty.

metadata.reconciliation_notes: 2026-07-18 Ola5 launched #623-636. Honest downgrades + new cost/plugin/security features. structured mem_search landed in same commit. overall=85%.
